thread:
Ana M: quick heads-up — packaging produced installer bundle `redwood-private-0.9.7` and signed-manifest v12. Local checksum validation passes but the remote signer failed a chunk upload.
Mike R: rough error? curl timeout or cosign rejects?
Ana M: infra-signer returned `415 unsupported media type` on one submanifest, then a 502 on retry. logs attached to the packaging job.
Sophia K: is that the offsite transit that runs the cosign step? Priya set a different content-type header last week for delta bundles.
Priya S: yep, the transport gate adds `Content-Type: application/vnd.redwood.installer+json`. I rolled a micro-change Tue; might be a mismatch with the signer endpoint expecting `application/json`.
Jon P: DeployBot queued preflight for the canary window at 03:00 UTC. If manifest v12 is not valid we need to pause before the canary push.
DeployBot: action: preflight-check started for bundle redwood-private-0.9.7. checks: [signatures, checksums, manifest-compat]. status: running.
Ana M: proposal: hold the canary, re-run signer with compatibility header, and produce a re-signed manifest v12.1. If signer still fails, fallback: republish using shrinkwrap artifact (immutable tarball) and pin the deploy to v11 -> v12 rollback path.
Mike R: Agree. Two questions: 1) Is there any customer-facing change that depends on v12? 2) How long to re-sign and re-run packaging?
Ana M: No user-facing schema changes. Re-sign should be ~8–10m once signer is healthy. Packaging rerun and checksum publish ~15m total.
Sophia K: If we pause the canary, we should create a short release note and pin the image tags so Dedicated customers don't auto-update. Recommend TTL 24h and a manual resume.
Priya S: I'll try flipping the header compatibility flag on a staging copy of the signer now. If it works I'll regenerate and push a new manifest id.
Infra-Signer-Bot: signer-service: received manifest upload attempt id=mnf-0x7f, content-type mismatched: expected application/json, got application/vnd.redwood.installer+json. See https://infra-logs/signer/mnf-0x7f
Jon P: ops plan: 1) pause canary (DeployBot) 2) Priya attempts compatibility push 3) on success, Ana republishes v12.1 and we run smoke tests 4) if smoke ok, resume canary; else trigger rollback to v11 pinned artifacts.
DeployBot: action: canary-pause issued by Jon P. canary window suspended.
Priya S: quick test: sent a test upload with `application/json` -> signer accepted, cosign attached. Re-running packaging now.
Ana M: starting packaging job `pack-3612345678-retry`. I'll tag output `v12.1` and include both cosign signatures + KMS envelope id.
Mike R: If packaging fails again, we should fallback to the sealed tarball flow: create shrinkwrap artifact, sign with local offline key (airgap) and notify customers about manual install steps. That path requires updating the release notes.
Sophia K: I'll draft the short release note: bullet points include: "canary paused for checksum re-signing", "no user schema changes", "expected resume within ~30m", and instructions for Dedicated customers to pin v11 if they prefer immediate stability. Share for ack.
Ana M: pack job finished, manifest v12.1 published. checksums: passed. cosign signatures x2 attached. pushing notification to release channel.
Infra-Signer-Bot: signer-service: upload accepted id=mnf-0x80, cosign sigs verified, kms-envelope=env-0345.
DeployBot: action: preflight-check completed for redwood-private-0.9.7 v12.1. results: smoke-tests=pass, signing=ok, checksums=ok.
Jon P: resume canary in 5. Rolling canary -> 10% for 15m then 50% -> 100% if stable. Keep the pause button ready.
Priya S: FYI, I'll open a quick PR to add an integration test for the content-type header to avoid regressions.
Mike R: ack. Thanks team — good catch. Once canary finishes I'll post final release note and update the release manifest in the docs repo.
Sophia K: releasing note posted in #announcements after full rollout. :shipit:
Ana M: closing thread once we confirm 100% rollout. thanks everyone.
